phases.name: Java Version Upgrade
phases.description: Upgrade Java 8 → 17 LTS — foundation for all subsequent modernization

phases.name: Spring Boot Framework Upgrade
phases.description: Upgrade Spring Boot 2.7.18 → 3.2.x+ with javax→jakarta namespace migration

phases.name: Code Modernization
phases.description: Replace deprecated patterns and anti-patterns with modern Spring 6.x equivalents

phases.name: Cloud-Readiness Remediation
phases.description: Fix AppCAT cloud-readiness violations for Azure deployment targets

phases.name: Operational Hardening
phases.description: Optional improvements for production-grade Azure deployment

tasks.title: Upgrade Java version from 8 to 17 in pom.xml
tasks.description: Update all Java version properties in pom.xml from Java 8 to Java 17 LTS. This is the prerequisite for Spring Boot 3.x which requires Java 17+.

changes.description: Change <java.version>8</java.version> → <java.version>17</java.version>
Change <maven.compiler.source>8</maven.compiler.source> → <maven.compiler.source>17</maven.compiler.source>
Change <maven.compiler.target>8</maven.compiler.target> → <maven.compiler.target>17</maven.compiler.target>

tasks.successCriteria: Project compiles with Java 17. mvn compile succeeds with no errors.

tasks.title: Update Dockerfile base images from JDK 8 to JDK 17
tasks.description: Replace outdated Docker base images with modern JDK 17 equivalents. Build stage: maven:3.8-openjdk-8 → maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-17. Runtime stage: tomcat:8.5-jdk8 → tomcat:10.1-jdk17-temurin (WAR deployment retained for now).

changes.description: Change FROM maven:3.8-openjdk-8 → FROM maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-17
Change FROM tomcat:8.5-jdk8 → FROM tomcat:10.1-jdk17-temurin

tasks.successCriteria: Docker image builds successfully with JDK 17 base images. docker build completes without errors.

tasks.title: Upgrade Spring Boot parent from 2.7.18 to 3.2.x
tasks.description: Update the Spring Boot parent POM version from 2.7.18 to the latest 3.2.x stable release. This automatically upgrades Spring Framework from 5.3.x to 6.1.x. Requires Java 17+ (task-1).

changes.description: Change spring-boot-starter-parent version from 2.7.18 to 3.2.x (latest stable)

tasks.successCriteria: Spring Boot 3.2.x parent resolves. mvn dependency:resolve succeeds.

tasks.title: Migrate javax.servlet JSTL dependency to jakarta namespace
tasks.description: Spring Boot 3.x uses Jakarta EE 9+, which moved from javax.* to jakarta.* namespace. Replace javax.servlet:jstl with the Jakarta equivalent for JSP/JSTL compatibility.

changes.description: Replace javax.servlet:jstl dependency with org.glassfish.web:jakarta.servlet.jsp.jstl and jakarta.servlet.jsp.jstl:jakarta.servlet.jsp.jstl-api

tasks.successCriteria: No javax.servlet imports remain. Project compiles with Jakarta JSTL dependencies.

tasks.title: Update JSP taglib URIs for Jakarta EE compatibility
tasks.description: JSP files using javax.servlet JSTL taglib URIs must be updated to Jakarta namespace URIs. All 6 JSP files need to be scanned and updated if they reference javax.* taglib URIs.

changes.description: Update JSTL taglib URIs: http://java.sun.com/jsp/jstl/core → jakarta.tags.core, http://java.sun.com/jsp/jstl/fmt → jakarta.tags.fmt (if applicable)

tasks.successCriteria: JSP pages render correctly with Jakarta JSTL tags. No javax.* taglib URIs remain.

tasks.title: Update Spring Boot application configuration for 3.x
tasks.description: Review and update application.yml and Spring Boot configuration for 3.x compatibility. Key changes: spring.mvc.view.prefix/suffix may need adjustment, property key renames, and deprecated configuration options.

changes.description: Review and update deprecated Spring Boot 2.x properties for 3.x compatibility
Verify SpringBootServletInitializer compatibility with Spring Boot 3.x

tasks.successCriteria: Application starts successfully on Spring Boot 3.2.x. mvn spring-boot:run succeeds.

tasks.title: Replace RestTemplate with RestClient (Spring 6.1+)
tasks.description: RestTemplate is in maintenance mode in Spring 6.x. Replace all RestTemplate usage with RestClient — the modern, synchronous HTTP client introduced in Spring Framework 6.1. Update AppConfig bean, BackendApiService, VendorApiService, and InventoryApiService.

changes.description: Replace RestTemplate @Bean with RestClient.builder().baseUrl(...).build() @Bean
Replace RestTemplate.exchange()/getForObject()/postForObject() calls with RestClient.get().uri(...).retrieve().body() equivalents
Replace RestTemplate calls with RestClient equivalents
Replace RestTemplate calls with RestClient equivalents

tasks.successCriteria: No RestTemplate imports remain. All API calls use RestClient. Application compiles and starts successfully.

tasks.title: Replace @Autowired field injection with constructor injection
tasks.description: Field injection via @Autowired is an anti-pattern that hinders testability and violates immutability. Migrate all controllers and services to use constructor injection (leveraging Lombok @RequiredArgsConstructor where appropriate).

changes.description: Remove @Autowired annotations. Add @RequiredArgsConstructor (Lombok). Change injected fields to private final.

tasks.successCriteria: No @Autowired field injection remains. All dependencies injected via constructor. Tests pass.

tasks.title: Replace System.out.println with SLF4J logger
tasks.description: The main application class uses System.out.println for startup messages. Replace with structured SLF4J logging using the @Slf4j Lombok annotation for consistency with the rest of the codebase.

changes.description: Add @Slf4j annotation. Replace System.out.println() calls with log.info() calls.

tasks.successCriteria: No System.out.println calls remain. Startup messages appear via SLF4J logger.

tasks.title: Update version string from LEGACY to SNAPSHOT
tasks.description: Update the project version from 1.0.0-LEGACY to a proper versioning scheme (e.g., 2.0.0-SNAPSHOT) to reflect the modernization. Also update the Dockerfile COPY artifact reference.

changes.description: Change <version>1.0.0-LEGACY</version> → <version>2.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
Update COPY artifact name to match new version

tasks.successCriteria: Build produces artifact with updated version name.

tasks.title: Externalize hardcoded backend URL via environment variables
tasks.description: Replace the hardcoded http://backend:8080/api URL in application.yml with an environment-variable-driven configuration pattern suitable for Azure deployment (Kubernetes ConfigMaps, App Service settings, Container Apps environment variables).

changes.description: Change backend.api.url from hardcoded value to ${BACKEND_API_URL:https://backend:8080/api} with environment variable override

tasks.successCriteria: Backend URL is configurable via BACKEND_API_URL environment variable. Default value provided for local development.

tasks.title: Switch HTTP to HTTPS for all service communication
tasks.description: Replace all http:// protocol references with https:// in source code and configuration files. Remove hardcoded localhost URLs from startup messages. This resolves AppCAT mandatory violations for unsecured network protocols.

changes.description: Change default backend URL protocol from http:// to https://
Remove hardcoded http://localhost:8081 reference from startup banner. Use dynamic port detection or remove.

tasks.successCriteria: No http:// protocol references remain in source code or config. No localhost references in runtime code. AppCAT re-scan shows 0 unsecure-network-protocol violations.

tasks.title: Add Spring Boot Actuator for health, readiness, and liveness probes
tasks.description: Add spring-boot-starter-actuator dependency and configure /health, /readiness, and /liveness endpoints. These are required by Azure App Service, AKS, and Container Apps for container orchestration health checks.

changes.description: Add spring-boot-starter-actuator dependency
Configure management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info and management.endpoint.health.probes.enabled=true

tasks.successCriteria: GET /actuator/health returns {"status":"UP"}. Readiness and liveness probes are accessible.

tasks.title: Add Kubernetes/Azure deployment manifests and health probe configuration
tasks.description: Create deployment configuration for Azure target platform (Container Apps, AKS, or App Service). Configure container health check endpoints, resource limits, and environment variable injection for the modernized application.

changes.description: Optimize for production: non-root user, health check instruction, minimal layers
Create Kubernetes deployment.yaml / Azure Container Apps config with health probes, env vars, and resource limits

tasks.successCriteria: Application is deployable to target Azure platform with automated health monitoring.
